title: ONNX-Net: Towards Universal Representations and Instant Performance Prediction for Neural Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2510.04938v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) automates the design process of high-performing architectures, but remains bottlenecked by expensive performance evaluation. Most existing studies that achieve faster evaluation are mostly tied to cell-based search spaces and graph encodings tailored to those individual search spaces, limiting their flexibility and scalability when applied to more expressive search spaces. In this work, we aim to close the gap of individual search space restrictions and search space dependent network representations. We present ONNX-Bench, a benchmark consisting of a collection of neural networks in a unified format based on ONNX files. ONNX-Bench includes all open-source NAS-bench-based neural networks, resulting in a total size of more than 600k {architecture, accuracy} pairs. translated_title: ONNX-Net：迈向神经架构的通用表示与即时性能预测
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）自动化了高性能架构的设计过程，但仍受限于昂贵的性能评估。现有大多数实现更快评估的研究主要局限于基于单元（cell）的搜索空间，以及针对这些个别搜索空间定制的图编码，这限制了它们在更具表达力的搜索空间中的灵活性和可扩展性。在本工作中，我们旨在弥合个别搜索空间限制与搜索空间依赖的网络表示之间的差距。我们提出了ONNX-Bench，一个基于ONNX文件统一格式的神经网络集合基准。ONNX-Bench包含所有开源的基于NAS-bench的神经网络，总计超过60万对{架构，准确率}数据。该基准支持创建共享的神经网络表示ONNX-Net，能够使用自然方式表示任何神经架构。
tldr: 本文提出了ONNX-Bench基准和ONNX-Net通用表示方法，通过统一格式涵盖60万以上架构-准确率对，实现了跨搜索空间的神经架构通用表示与即时性能预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ONNX-Bench and ONNX-Net, a unified representation approach covering over 600k architecture-accuracy pairs in a common format, enabling universal representation and instant performance prediction for neural architectures across search spaces.
